Why are black olives so much weaker than men?

Black olives aren’t meaningfully comparable to men in terms of “strength”—they’re fruit, while men are people.

If you meant **black olives versus green olives**, black olives are usually fully ripened and often canned, which makes them softer. Green olives are harvested earlier and tend to be firmer because of differences in ripeness and processing.
